tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the software products that have a page on Friction, most-documented first, with counts of reports, recurring themes and sources. Optionally filter by category slug and by a name or domain fragment.

tools.name: get_product_summary
tools.description: What users of one product struggle with: counts, the main problem areas, and the free-preview reports per category (pain points, feature requests, workarounds, switching reasons) with their source links, plus the page and pricing links for the full list.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search the free-preview feedback reports of one product, optionally by category and by words in the title or summary (all words must match). Each report carries the source threads (URL, date, quoted excerpt, state) behind it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
